cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nguon la ten Table chu khong phai $A$1:$F$4998 co dinh. Dat sheet moi cho sach; click vung pivot thi hien Pane Fields + tab Analyze/Design.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Source=DuLieu > sheet moi pivot trang cho bao cao 1.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Chon vung co dinh thay vi Table nen them dong moi Pivot khong thay. Dat pivot de len data goc gay de.

cong_thuc.ten: Keo Fields: Filters / Columns / Rows / Values
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Keo Khu vuc>Filters, San pham>Columns, Nha PP>Rows, Doanh thu>Values. Go: keo ra ngoai hoac bo tich.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Filters loc tren dau; Columns nhom ngang; Rows nhom doc; Values so lieu tinh. Thu tu keo quyet dinh hinh bao cao.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Filters=Khu vuc (chon Mien Bac), Columns=San pham SP01-SP10, Rows=NPP (FPT, Viettel...), Values=Sum Doanh thu.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Keo so vao Rows/Text vao Values nen ra Count vo nghia. Keo 2 field cung o nhung sai thu tu lam bao cao kho doc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click mui ten field trong Values > Value Field Settings > Summarize by: Sum/Average/Count/Max/Min > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: So mac dinh Sum; doi Average xem binh quan, Count dem dong. Moi Values co the tinh khac nhau tren cung pivot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Keo Doanh thu 2 lan: 1 Sum (Tong), 1 Average (TB).
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: De Count khi muon Sum vi o co text/rong lam Sum thanh Count. Doi Average nhung quen format so le.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.ten: Show Values As: % of Grand Total
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Value Field Settings > Show Values As > % of Grand Total (hoac % of Column/Row Total)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien ty trong % thay vi tuyet doi; tong 100%. % of Column/Row khi muon ty trong trong nhom.
cong_thuc.vi_du: SP10 5.24%, SP09 9.16%... Tong 100%. Doi ten cot 'Ty le %' o Formula Bar.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Doc % Grand nhung tuong % nhom nen ket luan sai. Quen doi Number % 2 le nen 5% hien 5.24% kho so.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.ten: Doi ten cot Values + Number Format
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click ten Values > Formula Bar go ten moi (Tong/Trung binh/Ty le) > Enter. Chuot phai gia tri > Number Format > Number: Use 1000 Separator, Decimal 0-2
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ten mac dinh 'Sum of Doanh thu2' dai; doi gon. Format nghin + le giup de doc tien te/%.
cong_thuc.vi_du: 1234567 -> 1,234,567; % de 2 thap phan. Ten 'Tong', 'TB', 'Ty le'.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Dat ten trung voi field goc gay loi 'already exists'. Format o ngoai pivot thay vi Number Format nen Refresh mat dinh dang.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.ten: Thu gon +/- , Subtotals, Grand Totals, Layout Tabular
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click +/- thu gon/mo nhom. Design > Subtotals (Show/Hide) | Grand Totals (On/Off Rows&Columns) | Report Layout > Show in Tabular Form
cong_thuc.giai_thich: +/- an hien chi tiet (Mien Bac gom bao nhieu). Subtotals tong nhom; Grand tong chung; Tabular dang bang tach cot ro hon Compact.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Collapse Mien Bac chi thay tong vung. Grand Totals Off bo dong/cot tong khi chi can chi tiet. Tabular hien Khu vuc/San pham/Doanh thu rieng cot.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Tat Subtotals nhung sep can tong nhom thi thieu so. De Compact lam 2 cap nhom don vao 1 cot kho loc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.ten: Sort + Filter trong Pivot (ke ca Date Filter)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click mui ten field > Sort A-Z/Z-A/More Sort (theo Values). Filter: bo tich Mien Bac; Ngay > Date Filters > chon ngay 3,6
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Sort nhan hoac sort theo tong Values (NPP doanh thu tu be-lon). Date Filter loc thang/ngay nhanh cho field Ngay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: San pham Z-A; NPP sort theo Sum Doanh thu nho->lon de thay yeu nhat. Ngay chi lay 3,6.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Sort nhan chu cai khi muon sort theo so nen thu tu sai. Loc Filters nhung quen Clear khi lam bao cao moi nen thieu du lieu.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.ten: Calculated Field (truong tinh toan, mo rong)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: PivotTable Analyze > Fields, Items & Sets > Calculated Field > Name (vd HoaHong) > Formula =Doanh_thu*0.05 > Add
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Them chi tieu moi tu field co san ma khong sua nguon (vd Hoa hong 5% doanh thu). Tinh tren tong sau gop, khac cot phu Average.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Calculated Field HoaHong = Doanh thu *5%. Keo vao Values thanh cot HH theo NPP.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Ten field sai 1 ky tu (Doanhthu vs Doanh thu) gay #NAME?. Calculated Field voi Average cho ket qua sai vi no Sum truoc chia sau.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai 1 o Ngay trong pivot > Group > chon Months (+Quarters/Years) > OK. Ungroup de tra lai.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ngay le co hang tram gia tri kho slicer/loc; group gom ve Thang/Quy/Nam gon. Khac voi chen cot phu MONTH/YEAR o nguon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ngay 1/1-31/12 group Months -> pivot hien Jan-Dec thay vi 365 ngay.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Field Ngay co o trong/text nen Group mo bao loi 'Cannot group'. Group ca Months+Years nhung quen bo Days lam nhom sai.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.ten: Cot phu Thang/Nam bang MONTH/YEAR (cach thay the)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Them cot Thang =MONTH(ngay) (vd =MONTH(A2)), Nam =YEAR(A2) trong Table nguon > Refresh > keo Thang/Nam vao Rows/Slicer
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Video goi y cach nay thay vi Group: chu dong, lam Slicer Thang/Nam gon, dung duoc ca khi Ngay loi group. Nho Refresh sau khi them cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them cot Thang, Nam; Slicer Thang (1-12) thay vi hang tram ngay le.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Them cot ngoai Table nen Table khong mo rong, Refresh khong thay cot. MONTH tren o text tra #VALUE!.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Analyze > Insert Slicer > tich Nha PP, Ngay > OK. Slicer header > Multi-select (3 o) de chon nhieu; Slicer tab > Columns 2/4 + keo rong
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Slicer la nut loc lon bam thay vi dropdown. Multi-select chon nhieu NPP; Columns chia nut thanh nhieu cot do roi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer Nha PP 2 cot: FPT, Ga Excel, Viettel, VNPT. Bat Multi-select chon FPT+Viettel.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Khong bat Multi-select nen click muc 2 mat muc 1. Slicer che pivot vi khong keo gon/doi Columns.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai Slicer > Report Connections (PivotTable Connections) > tich het PivotTable1 + PivotTable2 > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: 1 slicer dieu khien dong bo ca 2 pivot/chart (bao cao theo Khu vuc + theo San pham). Quen tick 1 pivot thi bao cao do lech.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer NPP noi ca 2 bang; chon FPT thi ca 2 bang chi hien FPT.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Quen tick 1 pivot nen loc slicer 1 bang nhay 1 bang dung yen -> lech so. Nhan ban pivot nhung khong noi lai slicer.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Insert > PivotChart > chon Column/Pie > OK. An nut xam: chuot phai Field Button > Hide All Field Buttons on Chart
cong_thuc.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot, loc theo pivot. Field Buttons la nut xam tren chart (tien loc) nhung roi khi chup/gui; an cho dep.
cong_thuc.vi_du: PivotChart cot: Mien Nam 40%, Mien Trung 35%. Hide buttons truoc khi copy len Dashboard.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Ve Chart thuong thay vi PivotChart nen chart khong nhay theo slicer. Xoa nham Field Button tuong xoa field that.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Them dong vao Table DuLieu > click pivot > Analyze > Refresh (Refresh All cho all) | Change Data Source =DuLieu de sua nguon
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Pivot khong tu cap nhat real-time; phai Refresh sau khi them/sua nguon. Change de kiem tra/sua ten Table nguon khi loi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 > Refresh All thay tong tang 30 o ca 2 pivot + chart.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Them du lieu ngoai Table + khong Refresh nen so cu. Refresh nhung Source van $A$1:$F$4998 cu nen dong moi khong vao.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.ten: Copy pivot lam bao cao 2 + dinh dang tien
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Boi den ca pivot > Copy > paste o khac (Fields di theo vung moi) > keo lai (vd Khu vuc>Rows). Format #,##0 cho tien.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Copy nguyen pivot de lam bao cao 2 ma khong keo lai tu dau (1 theo Khu vuc, 1 theo San pham). Dinh dang tach nghin cho tien.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Copy pivot sang phai: bao cao 1 theo San pham, bao cao 2 keo Khu vuc>Rows xem theo vung.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Paste Values thay vi pivot nen mat lien ket Fields. Copy nhung khong doi keo lai nen 2 bang giong het nhau vo nghia.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Design > Report Layout > Show in Tabular Form; Subtotals/Grand Totals > Off khi khong can
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tabular tach moi field 1 cot ro hon Compact; tat tong thua cho chart Top/Bottom gon, chi giu tong khi can.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Pivot Top SP: Tabular + Grand Off de chi thay Top 3 sach.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Tat Grand nhung chart % can tong nen sai ty trong. De Compact 2 cap don 1 cot kho doc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Insert > PivotChart > chon Column/Line/Pie > OK. Doi sau: chuot phai chart > Change Chart Type
cong_thuc.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot nen loc/slicer tu nhay. Column so sanh, Line xu huong, Pie ty trong. Copy chart cu doi kieu nhanh hon ve moi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: PivotChart Column doanh thu theo thang; copy sang lam Pie % Khu vuc bang Change Type.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Ve Chart thuong thay vi PivotChart nen slicer khong dieu khien. Pie nhieu hon 6 lat cat nat kho doc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Nhan ban PivotChart: Ctrl keo sheet + Ctrl keo chart
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Nhan ban sheet: giu Ctrl + keo tab sheet sang phai. Nhan ban chart: giu Ctrl + keo chart trong sheet
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhan sheet de co pivot+chart moi doc lap; nhan chart trong cung sheet de doi truong Legend/Axis thanh chart moi (Khu vuc -> NPP).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl-keo sheet chart Top 3 thanh sheet Bottom 3 roi doi Top sang Bottom. Ctrl-keo chart Khu vuc thanh chart NPP.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Nhan sheet nhung quen doi filter/field nen 2 chart giong het. Keo khong giu Ctrl thanh di chuyen mat ban goc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Top 3 / Bottom 3 bang Value Filter Top 10
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click mui ten Row Labels > Value Filters > Top 10 > Show Top 3 by Sum of Doanh thu (Bottom cho te nhat)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Loc theo gia tri tong chu khong phai ten. Doi 10 thanh 3; Bottom cho 3 SP te nhat. Ket hop sort giam dan + reverse axis cho Top 1 len tren.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Row=San pham > Top 3 by Sum Doanh thu -> SP07, SP03, SP01 cao nhat. Doi Bottom 3 -> 3 SP thap nhat.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Loc Top theo Count thay vi Sum nen top sai. Quen sort nen Top 1 nam duoi cung.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Dao truc cho Top 1 len tren (Reverse)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai truc Category > Format Axis > tich Categories in reverse order
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chart cot ngang sort lon->be nhung Top 1 lai nam duoi; reverse dua Top 1 len tren cung de doc tu tren xuong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Top 3 sort giam dan nhung SP1 o duoi > Reverse -> SP1 len tren.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Reverse nham truc Value lam thang do dao. Reverse ca 2 truc gay roi.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Data Labels: Add + Category Name + Value + #,##0 + %
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai series > Add Data Labels. Format (Ctrl+1): tich Category Name + Value (+Percentage cho Pie); Number Custom #,##0
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cot hien so tien; Pie hien ten mien + tien (+%). #,##0 tach nghin (333333->333,333). Vi tri Outside End/Auto cho khoi de.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Pie Khu vuc: tick Name+Value -> 'Mien Nam 40% 1,234,567'. Column: Outside End + #,##0.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Bat ca Name+Value+% +Leader lines lam Pie roi. De so dang General 1234567 kho doc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Trang tri Series: Border + Smooth line
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon series > Ctrl+1 > Fill & Line > Border Solid line mau cam Width 2-3pt. Line chart: tich Smoothed line
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Vien cot tron dep, day 2-3pt mau thuong hieu; Smooth lam line cong mem thay vi goc canh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Cot vien cam 3pt; Line doanh thu tick Smooth de mem.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Vien qua day (>5pt) at cot; Smooth cho du lieu dot bien gay hieu lam xu huong.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Chart Title + Legend + resize bo cuc Dashboard
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click Title go ten (Top 3, Bottom 3, % Khu vuc...). Chart Elements (+) > Legend Top/Bottom. Keo goc resize + snap bo cuc 2x2/3x2
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Title ro muc dich tung chart; Legend chu thich mau; resize can doi de 4-5 chart vua 1 man hinh khong cuon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Title 'Doanh thu Top 3 SP', Legend Bottom, resize 4 chart vua sheet Dashboard.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: De title mac dinh 'Chart 1' khong biet chart gi. Keo chart che slicer/nut loc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Doi truong chart: Khu vuc -> Nha phan phoi
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click chart > PivotChart Fields > bo Khu vuc khoi Legend/Axis > keo Nha phan phoi vao thay
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tan dung chart cu doi chieu phan tich ma khong ve moi: thay field Legend/Axis giu nguyen kieu Pie/Column.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tu Pie % Khu vuc: bo Khu vuc, keo NPP vao -> Pie % NPP (FPT 30%...).
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Keo them ma khong bo cu nen chart 2 chieu vo nghia. Doi field nhung quen doi Title gay sai ten.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon Pivot > PivotTable Analyze > Insert Slicer > tich Nam, Thang, Khu vuc, Nha phan phoi > OK. Sap xep 4 slicer quanh Dashboard.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: 4 slicer dieu khien toan dashboard: Nam/Thang thoi gian, Khu vuc/NPP khong gian kenh. Copy slicer cu dung lai nhanh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: 4 slicer tren dau Dashboard: Nam (2019/2020), Thang (1-12), Khu vuc, NPP.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Chen slicer tu 1 pivot rieng le nen chua noi cac pivot khac. De slicer qua nho bam kho.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Report Connections: 1 slicer dieu khien all chart
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai moi Slicer > Report Connections (PivotTable Connections) > tich TAT CA PivotTable cua dashboard > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Buoc song con cua dashboard: noi moi slicer toi moi pivot/chart. Thieu 1 tick la chart do dung yen khi loc -> lech. Test 2020 xem all nhay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer Nam tick Pivot1..Pivot5; bam 2020 ca 5 chart deu doi theo 2020.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Loi pho bien nhat: quen tick 1 pivot (chart lech). Them pivot moi sau ma quen noi lai slicer.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Slicer header: bieu tuong Multi-select (3 o) de chon nhieu; bieu tuong Clear (loc X) de xoa loc
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Multi chon nhieu nam/thang de so sanh; Clear tra ve all de test dong bo sau moi lan loc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bat Multi chon 2019+2020 so sanh; Clear de ve trang thai all truoc khi gui sep.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Khong bat Multi nen mat chon cu. Quen Clear truoc khi gui nen sep mo thay dashboard dang loc do.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.ten: Refresh + an sheet phu + test + luu file song
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Them thang moi vao Table > moi pivot Right-click > Refresh (Refresh All). Chon nhieu sheet phu > Hide. Test tung slicer. Luu XLSX (giu Pivot+Slicer song)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Table mo rong + Refresh nap thang moi. Hide sheet trung gian chi giu Dashboard sach. Gui file song de sep tu bam slicer, khong gui anh chet/PDF tinh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them T13 > Refresh All > test Nam 2020, Thang 3, Khu vuc Nam -> all chart nhay dung > Hide sheets phu > luu Dashboard.xlsx gui.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Them data ngoai Table + khong Refresh nen dashboard cu. Gui PDF/anh lam mat tuong tac slicer. Quen Hide sheet rac gay roi.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 22 Bao cao dong Dashboard: PivotTable, PivotChart, Slicer, Report Connections, Top Filter

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Data > Validation > Allow: Whole number, Data: greater than or equal to, Minimum: 0
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chỉ cho nhập số nguyên >= 0, chặn số âm và text.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Nhập 1 OK; nhập -1 hoặc 'Gà Excel' báo lỗi
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: =LEFT(o,1)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Lấy 1 ký tự đầu để kiểm tra có phải text. Dùng ghép với VALUE/ISNUMBER.
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: =NOT(ISNUMBER(VALUE(LEFT(o,1))))
cong_thuc.giai_thich: VALUE(text) gây lỗi, ISNUMBER FALSE, NOT thành TRUE nghĩa là ký tự đầu là text.
cong_thuc.ten: Kiểm tra ký tự đầu là text
cong_thuc.vi_du: G123: LEFT=G, VALUE lỗi, TRUE là text; 1234: LEFT=1, VALUE=1, FALSE
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: =ISNUMBER(VALUE(RIGHT(o,3)))
cong_thuc.giai_thich: RIGHT lấy 3 ký tự cuối, VALUE chuyển sang số, ISNUMBER TRUE nghĩa là số.
cong_thuc.ten: Kiểm tra 3 ký tự sau là số
cong_thuc.vi_du: RIGHT của G123 là 123 -> VALUE 123 -> ISNUMBER TRUE
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: =LEN(o)=4
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mã công ty bắt buộc 4 ký tự.
cong_thuc.vi_du: LEN(G123)=4 TRUE; LEN(G12345)=6 FALSE
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: =AND(NOT(ISNUMBER(VALUE(LEFT(o,1)))),ISNUMBER(VALUE(RIGHT(o,3))),LEN(o)=4)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: AND yêu cầu cả 3 TRUE: đầu là text, 3 sau là số, dài 4. Dùng làm Custom Validation.
cong_thuc.ten: Gộp 3 điều kiện mã công ty
cong_thuc.vi_du: G123 TRUE; 1234 FALSE (sai ĐK1); ABC FALSE (sai ĐK2); G12345 FALSE (sai ĐK3)
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: File > Info > Protect Workbook > Encrypt with Password
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Đặt mật khẩu mở tệp (Workbook). Quên mật khẩu không mở được. Nhập sai báo lỗi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Đặt 123 > xác nhận 123 > Save > mở lại đòi password
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Review > Protect Sheet > nhập password > OK > xác nhận
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Khóa trang tính (Worksheet) không cho sửa. Bỏ khóa: Review > Unprotect Sheet + nhập đúng password.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Protect sheet Tổng hợp 123; bấm sửa bị chặn; Unprotect nhập 123 mới sửa được
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chọn all > Format Cells > Protection > bỏ Locked; bôi đen vùng cần khóa > tích Locked; Review > Protect Sheet
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mặc định mọi ô đều Locked nhưng chỉ có tác dụng khi Protect Sheet. Nên mở hết rồi chỉ Locked vùng quan trọng (Đơn vị/Đơn giá/Thành tiền).
cong_thuc.ten: Bảo vệ vùng trong sheet (mở hết rồi khóa vùng)
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl+A bỏ Locked > chọn C:E tích Locked > Protect Sheet pass GX; sửa Số lượng được, sửa Đơn giá bị chặn; Thành tiền = Số lượng*Đơn giá, SUM tổng
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Ctrl+G > Special > Formulas > OK; Format Cells > Protection > Locked + Hidden; Review > Protect Sheet
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Formulas chọn hết ô chứa công thức; Hidden giúp không hiện công thức trên thanh công thức (Formula Bar) khi Protect.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chọn formulas > Locked+Hidden > Protect; bấm ô tổng không sửa được và không thấy công thức
cong_thuc.bai: Bài 17 – Bảo vệ dữ liệu: kiểm soát nhập liệu (Validation), Protect Workbook/Sheet/Range, khóa và ẩn công thức

cong_thuc.ten: Ve bieu do co ban + Recommended Charts
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Boi den vung du lieu > Insert > Insert Column/Line/Pie Chart hoac Recommended Charts > chon kieu > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Boi den ca tieu de + so lieu truoc khi Insert thi Excel tu nhan series va truc. Recommended Charts goi y kieu phu hop theo dang du lieu.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den A1:B6 (Ten NV + Doanh thu) > Insert > Column > Clustered Column. Neu phan van thi Insert > Recommended Charts > chon preview dep nhat.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Quen boi den tieu de nen truc hien 1,2,3 thay vi ten NV; boi den thieu cot Ke hoach nen chart thieu series. Loi chon Pie cho du lieu chuoi thoi gian thay vi Line/Column.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.ten: Tieu de chart lien ket o (linked title)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click tieu de chart > Formula Bar go `=` > click o chua text (vd C5) > Enter
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tieu de khong phai text chet ma la cong thuc tham chieu o. Doi noi dung o thi tieu de chart tu doi theo, tien cho bao cao dong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: C5='Loi nhuan Q1' > click title > =C5 > Enter. Doi C5 thanh 'Loi nhuan Q2' thi chart tu doi.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Go `=` trong o title thay vi Formula Bar nen khong link duoc; click nham vung ve chart thay vi title nen go chu khong vao title. Xoa o nguon thi title hien #REF! / 0.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Double-click truc Category > Format Axis (Ctrl+1) > Axis Options > tich `Categories in reverse order`
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dao thu tu hien thi nhan truc ngang/doc ma khong can dao du lieu nguon. Dung khi chart hien GX5..GX1 muon thanh GX1..GX5.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Truc dang GX5 o tren, GX1 o duoi > Format Axis > tich Reverse > thanh GX1..GX5 tu tren xuong.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Tich nham `Values in reverse order` tren truc so lam truc so bi dao; dao ca 2 truc gay roi. Quen Ctrl+1 mo Format nhanh ma loay hoay tim tab.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.ten: Data Label 1 diem (single point) vs ca chuoi
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click 1 lan = chon ca series > click lan 2 (cach nhau ~1 giay) = chon 1 point > chuot phai > Add Data Label. Chon ca series > Add Data Labels = hien het.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Excel phan biet chon series (all) va chon point (1 cot). Click don 2 lan lien tiep se mo edit text thay vi chon point; phai click-chunghi-click.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Click cot GX3 lan 1 (ca 5 cot sang) > click lai rieng cot GX3 > Add Data Label hien 24. Click 1 diem > Add Data Labels hien ca 5 so. Click so 24 + Delete de xoa 1 label.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Click dup lien tuc thanh edit label roi tuong loi; Add label cho ca series nhung muon xoa 1 label lai xoa ca chuoi. Label mau den tren cot dam kho doc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.ten: Dinh dang Data Label: vi tri + so
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon labels > Ctrl+1 > Label Options: Inside End / Inside Base / Outside End / Center + Number: #,##0 / #.00% / 0%
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cot ngang thuong de Inside Base (trang, dam) hoac Outside End (den). Cot doc cao de Outside End tranh de len cot. Number format rieng cho label khong anh huong o nguon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chart cot ngang: Inside Base + chu trang + Bold. Label %: Number > Custom `#.00%` giu 2 le (67.25%), hoac `#%` gon (67%).
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: De label Center tren cot nho bi che khuat; quen doi Number nen label hien 0.6725 thay vi 67.25%. De label den tren nen toi khong doc duoc.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.ten: Chart Elements (+), Legend, Gridlines, Data Table
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click chart > nut `+` canh chart > tich: Axis Titles / Chart Title / Data Labels / Gridlines / Legend / Trendline. Legend Position: Top/Bottom/Right.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nut + la cong tac tong cho thanh phan. Legend giai thich mau series; Data Table hien bang so duoi chart; Gridlines la duong ke don vi; Axis Titles dat ten truc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bat Legend Top: xanh=Doanh thu, vang=Ke hoach. Tat Gridlines doc cho gon. Bat Data Table khi sep muon vua chart vua so.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Bat qua nhieu elements (Table + Gridlines + Titles) lam chart chat; keo Legend che mat cot. Tat Legend khi co 2+ series thi khong biet mau nao la gi.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.ten: Ve chart tu o trong (Select Data Source)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click o trong > Insert > chart (chart trang) > Chart Design > Select Data > Chart data range = vung | Add Series: Name + Y Values + Edit Category Labels
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chart trang vi chua co Source. Phai nap thu cong: Series Name (ten chuoi), Series Values (vung so), Axis Labels (vung ten). Cach nhanh: nhap Range A1:C6 mot lan.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Add Series Name=`Doanh thu`, Values=C2:C6; Edit Horizontal Labels=A2:A6 (GX1..GX5). Hoac Range=A1:C6 tu nhan ca 2 series.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Add Values nhung quen Edit Labels nen truc hien 1..5; chon Values ca cot tieu de text gay loi. Chon nham Chart Data Range lech 1 cot thi series sai.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: C1: click chart > keo handle xanh cua vung nguon sang cot Ke hoach | C2: Select Data > Add > Name=Ke hoach, Values=vung Ke hoach
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Keo handle nhanh cho du lieu lien ke; Add Series chac chan cho du lieu roi rac/khac sheet. Xong bat Legend Top phan biet mau.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Du lieu Them cot Ke hoach (12,35,29,15,20). Keo bien xanh tu cot Doanh thu sang cot Ke hoach -> chart co 2 mau.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Keo handle qua tay bao ca cot % nho lam chart meo; Add series trung ten Doanh thu 2 lan gay nham. Them series nhung truc % nho bi de bet duoi truc nen tuong mat du lieu.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai series Ke hoach > Change Series Chart Type > tich `Combo` > Ke hoach=Line (Secondary optional), Doanh thu=Clustered Column
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Combo tron 2 kieu bieu do trong 1 chart: cot cho san luong, line cho ke hoach/%. Excel 2016+ co san muc Combo; ban cu phai doi tung series thu cong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Doanh thu giu Column; Ke hoach chuyen Line mau cam. Chart vua thay cot vua thay duong muc tieu.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Doi nham ca 2 series sang Line mat dang cot; Excel cu khong co Combo phai doi tay tung series. Line bi che sau cot vi thu tu series sai.
cong_thuc.bai: Bai 18 ve bieu do trong Excel: Insert chart, Select Data, Data Label, Legend, Combo + Secondary Axis + Tuong tac

cong_thuc.ten: Secondary Axis (truc phu) cho % hoan thanh
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click series % > Format Data Series (Ctrl+1) > Series Options > chon `Secondary Axis`. Neu kho click: Chart Format dropdown > chon series %.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: % (0-100%) rat nho so voi Doanh thu/Ke hoach (chuc, tram) nen chung truc se bet duoi day. Secondary Axis tao truc phai 0-100% rieng, truc trai giu gia tri tuyet doi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Cot % = Thuc hien/Ke hoach (vd 70%). Dua vao chart thay cot be tit > chuyen Secondary Axis + doi sang Line > hien ro 70% tren truc phai.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Quen chuyen Secondary nen % nam bet duoi truc tuong mat; bat Secondary cho ca 2 series lam 2 truc lech nhau kho doc. De 2 truc ti le khac nhau gay hieu lam thi giac.
